ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark gray to black pixels across the entire surface; extremely low white-to-black ratio estimated at < 0.05 based on sparse speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark gray base layer across both lobes; vertical high-density dark band at the peduncle-fluke junction; high-frequency distribution of micro-scale high-intensity pixel clusters (speckling) across the medial and distal surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle; depth is minimal relative to total fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with low-amplitude irregularities; minor indentation located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately midway between the notch and the tip; left lobe edge appears relatively smooth with micro-undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, slightly upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dotted spatial detection of isolated high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring or micro-pigmentation, distributed randomly across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped nick or trailing-edge irregularity on the right lobe distal to the median notch.
